arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title and current date."""
import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

# 1. Create cover page PDF
cover_path = "cover.pdf"
width, height = letter
c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)

# Title centered on page
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 30, "Annual Financial Report")

# Current date
today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 30, today)

c.save()

# 2. Merge cover page with the existing report
reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()

cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])

for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open("report_with_cover.pdf", "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print("Created report_with_cover.pdf with", len(writer.pages), "pages")
